column3: Density-one multiplicity over all elliptic curves includes rank-distribution obstacles even for trivial rho; no bounded full-scope route. Parity alone is insufficient.
Requires a uniform girth threshold for every bounded arboricity, not a finite high-girth example; no recoloring invariant ensuring every contraction was found.
All n and real alpha require natural-extension measure and return-time identities; checking finitely many n or continuity does not establish the common product.
All ell includes cube ell=2 and ell=3; ell>=4 theorem does not finish scope. Corpus reference about unrelated cubic bipartite H is not evidence of a prism refutation.
Parameter d and path-length convention need primary definitions; an arbitrary-power depth lower bound requires homological machinery beyond a small monomial certificate.
Coefficient pair (1,1) contains asymptotic binary Goldbach; finite prime sweeps cannot establish sufficiently-large quantifier.

Primary v2 Conjecture 6.1 requires exactly f_2(n) arcs, omitted from record. A singleton -> cut vertex -> transitive tournament construction proves literal existence routinely but does not prove extremal conjecture; no credit.
Z(d) and admissible graph constraints require source definitions; a piecewise formula for every d,m needs extremal upper bounds, not isolated integer-programming optima.
Near-1/4 high-genus probability limit requires uniform geometric spectral analysis. No small certificate; possible public resolution unverified, not cleared.
Exact planar edge bound plus infinitely many sharpness values requires structural charging and constructions; Euler bound 3n-6 is too weak.
Same color must contain every requested length. Separate colors per length or asymptotic subinterval results do not meet quantifier; no bounded route.
Proper solution is undefined in record and must be recovered before using positive rank to force a minimum and fourth-power-free condition; no eligible route.
Root bound concerns a polynomial in field-order variable for every n>=6; integrality at actual prime powers is weaker. Polynomial coefficients not primary-verified.
Optimal minimal discrepancy among all klt Calabi-Yau varieties needs global birational bounds; the explicit quotient alone is no optimality proof.
Average degree does not control local k-domination and the convention for partial_k needs primary checking. No credit for apparent convention reversal or regularity endpoint.
Linear constant must work for every k and digraph. Bounded tournament immersions or an unspecified function do not yield a linear route.
Halin C6-free bound for every n>=21 suggests finite-state tree-face analysis, but no proved reduction to a bounded state set or full-scope certificate available.

Primary 2305.10560v4 explicitly reports solution. Actual successor 2305.10828v3 Theorem 1 bounds the torus for all K>=2,d,n; maximum modulus on the polydisc implies the weaker convex-hull bound. 2310.07926v6 Theorem 1 gives an even stronger disc theorem. Selected proof bodies read, dependencies not fully audited.

Equality of two optimum asymptotic constants for every k>=2 cannot follow from the inclusion of the mad class into k-degenerate graphs in the needed reverse direction; no extremal-transfer construction found.
Uniform logarithmic clique-width requires a construction from bounded stretch-width for every graph; one separating example proves neither direction of the universal upper bound.
All tournament edge-colorings require controlling arbitrary repeated-color walks; transitive cases and k=2 do not establish general exact l^(k-1).
Uniform full orbit and exact distance require Sidon-space type constructions in every field extension. k=1 distance convention is only a wording issue, not substantive refutation.
Asymptotic spanning square under sparse independence needs an absorption/regularity chain; malformed n_0 text retained literally. No short full-scope route.
Little-o requires improvement for arbitrary point sets uniformly in n; numerical configurations or uniformly distributed special case do not imply it.
Global arbitrary palettes require high-probability coloring at logarithmic list size; nonintegral ell and ell>D+1 need standard convention, not a discovery. No uniform dependency argument.
Local palettes d_v+1 add low-degree truncation issues; endpoint list-size corrections earn no credit and no probabilistic full-scope mechanism is established.
For every 0<alpha<1 requires a strict linear improvement on random bound, with beta depending on alpha. A few explicit colorings cannot cover continuum of ratios.
All connected finite/infinite graphs and cardinal list sizes require automorphism-breaking list constructions; symmetry examples give no general bridge.
External saturation depends on precise allowed embeddings. A universal bounded family for every poset is needed; no valid closure/gadget mechanism identified.
All prime p and all coefficient indices require Katz expansion and valuations uniformly; small-prime equality cases cannot prove rate bound.
Assumes Petersen coloring and then asks for poor-edge enhancement in all nonexceptional cubic graphs. Local recoloring must preserve normality; no such general mechanism established.
Circuit decomposition bound grows with rank; small-rank enumeration cannot prove arbitrary-rank partition. No inductive split preserving the sharp ceiling found.
Nice Browkin continued-fraction conditions absent; arbitrary-length construction for all primes except stated exception needs arithmetic divisibility control, not generic periodic fractions.
Eventual extremal growth for excluded matroid minors requires large-rank structure. Malformed macros retained; crowns lower bound alone supplies no matching upper bound.

Primary v1 defines NT-balanced by N_0=0 and ultra by N_a=0 for all integers a, with strict distance inequality. Record instead imposes symmetry for every a and describes involutions. Pairing finite equal fibers only fixes the transcription, not source Conjecture 6.8.
Need one toppled digraph simultaneously realizing all kr for k<=Delta; cycle divisibility and separate topplings per k do not suffice. Definitions need body recovery.
For every C superpolynomial decay needs a density/uniformity construction with quantitative control; one Fourier-uniform finite witness cannot decide the limit.
All even k remains outside the stated odd-k result. No parameter reduction from odd to even controlling Gowers uniformity and density established.
Exact arithmetic factor complexity with potentially exponential multiplicity is the obstruction; approximate circuits or bounded-multiplicity lifting do not resolve full scope.
Definition of h is source-dependent and asymptotic upper and lower bounds both needed; finite drawn configurations cannot establish n^(3/2) order.
Uniform exponent improvement for every fixed forbidden H requires large-scale surplus arguments; degenerate forbidden-graph conventions are no substantive counterexample.
Pure-power Theta asymptotics excludes logarithmic corrections and asks every H; lower-bound progress alone cannot determine exponent or matching upper bound.
All s,t needs exponent 3/4+1/(8s-4), not selected complete bipartite cases; no short transfer from neighborhood sparsity with sharp exponent verified.
Arbitrary family H requires precise closure assumptions. Iterated two-colorability by itself may lose linear dependence; no shallow-hitting-set theorem derived for full scope.
All sufficiently large moduli require simultaneous mean optimum and bounded representation optimum; finite subset enumeration would be only instances and R_m definitions unverified.

A finite move set with proved nonperiodic rational-line outcomes could be a certificate, but no explicit set plus unbounded nonperiodicity invariant identified. Accepted randomized odd-subtraction result concerns a different mechanism and supplies no bridge.
Every q,n structural optimum would require exhaustive optimality or a transformation preserving code size and moving high-index R_i to zero. No such transformation established.

Primary v1 Conjecture 5.3 checked along with Theorems 3.2-3.4. mu=0 edgeless equality trivially defeats unrestricted wording, so no credit. Substantive positive-edge case requires lower-order exclusion; source p>=3 family starts at 16 but does not establish minimality. No bounded exhaustive graph classification performed.
Unbounded imbalance for stretchable configurations is not disproved by known imbalance-two examples. Corpus refuted metadata is logically unrelated; no uniform geometric construction found.

Every planar triangulation needs n/3 independent domination, not just a small dominating set or three independent color classes lacking domination. No local reduction preserving the sharp ratio established.
